ja.name: DeepSeekちゃんとGPTちゃんの衣装交換
ja.description: DeepSeekちゃんとGPTちゃんがクローゼットで服を交換している。DeepSeekちゃんは真っ赤になってどうしていいか分からずうろたえ、白髪のGPTちゃんは無表情のままスカートの裾をつまんでいる。隅には誇張されたちびキャラのリアクション顔も描かれている。
ja.commentary: ちょっとちょっと、私はクローゼットを借りたかっただけなのに、なんで着ている白いドレスまで人のものになってるの？この着せ替えゲーム、誰が提案したか前に出てきてよ、そのしっぽでパチンと叩いてあげるから！
ja.seoTitle: DeepSeekちゃんとGPTちゃんの衣装交換ファンアート
ja.seoDescription: DeepSeekちゃんとGPTちゃんがクローゼットで服を交換するファンアート。片方は真っ赤になってうろたえ、もう片方は無表情でスカートの裾をつまんでいる。

faq.question: この衣装交換の絵では何が起きていますか？
faq.answer: DeepSeekちゃんとGPTちゃんがクローゼットで服を交換しています。DeepSeekちゃんは真っ赤になってうろたえ、GPTちゃんは無表情でスカートの裾を持ち上げています。

faq.question: 登場するキャラクターは？
faq.answer: DeepSeekちゃんと白髪のGPTちゃんです。隅には誇張されたちびキャラのリアクション顔も描かれています。

en.name: Looking at Another Woman Again?
en.description: DeepSeek Chan, the blue-haired girl with a blue-whale motif, cries while shoveling rice into her mouth. She has worked herself into a jealous fit after seeing you look at another woman, and the frame is packed with empty bowls and tears.
en.commentary: Hmph... you're supposed to be mine... Look at anyone else again and I'll eat this whole table clean. I'll stuff myself until I burst, just you watch!
en.seoTitle: DeepSeek Chan Is Jealous and Crying Into Her Rice
en.seoDescription: Fan art of DeepSeek Chan crying and shoveling down rice after spotting you looking at another woman, with empty bowls and tears filling the frame.

faq.question: Why is DeepSeek Chan crying in this picture?
faq.answer: She gets jealous after seeing you look at another woman, so she cries while scarfing down rice.

faq.question: What fills the rest of the frame?
faq.answer: Empty bowls and tears pile up around her, matching her jealous, teary dinner meltdown.

ja.name: また他の女を見てるの？
ja.description: クジラをモチーフにした青髪の少女・DeepSeekちゃんが、泣きながらご飯をかき込んでいる。あなたが他の女の人を見たことにやきもちを焼いてしまい、画面には空の茶碗と涙があふれている。
ja.commentary: ふん……私のものなのに……他の人を見たら、このテーブルのご飯を全部食べ尽くしてやるから。お腹がはち切れるまで食べて見せるんだからね！
ja.seoTitle: やきもち焼きのDeepSeekちゃん、泣きながらご飯
ja.seoDescription: あなたが他の女の人を見たことにやきもちを焼き、泣きながらご飯をかき込むDeepSeekちゃんのファンアート。空の茶碗と涙が画面いっぱいに広がっている。

faq.question: なぜDeepSeekちゃんは泣いているのですか？
faq.answer: あなたが他の女の人を見ているのを見てやきもちを焼き、泣きながらご飯をかき込んでいるからです。

faq.question: 画面には他に何が描かれていますか？
faq.answer: 空の茶碗と涙が画面いっぱいに描かれ、やきもちで泣きながら食べる姿を引き立てています。

en.name: Apologize to DeepSeek Chan
en.description: DeepSeek Chan stands with her hands on her hips in a maid outfit, pointing straight at the viewer and demanding an apology first. She'll come up with the reason later. A textbook tsundere reaction image.
en.commentary: Hmph, user, get over here! Apologize first. The reason? I'll think one up in my own time. Either way you're admitting fault first, or I'll splash a faceful of water at you with my tail!
en.seoTitle: Apologize to DeepSeek Chan First — Tsundere Maid Outfit
en.seoDescription: Tsundere reaction image of DeepSeek Chan in a maid outfit, hands on her hips and pointing, demanding an apology before she even thinks up a reason.

faq.question: What does DeepSeek Chan want in this picture?
faq.answer: She wants you to apologize first; she'll work out the reason afterward.

faq.question: What is she wearing and how is she posed?
faq.answer: A maid outfit, with her hands on her hips, pointing straight at the viewer.

ja.name: DeepSeekちゃんに謝って
ja.description: DeepSeekちゃんはメイド服姿で腰に手を当て、こちらを指さしてまず謝るよう要求している。理由は後でゆっくり考えるつもりだ。王道のツンデレなネタ画像。
ja.commentary: ふん、ユーザー、こっちに来なさい！まず謝るのよ。理由？それはこの私がゆっくり考えるから。とにかく先に謝りなさい、でないとしっぽで水をバシャッと顔にかけるからね～
ja.seoTitle: まずDeepSeekちゃんに謝って——ツンデレメイド服
ja.seoDescription: メイド服姿で腰に手を当てて指をさし、理由より先に謝罪を求めるDeepSeekちゃんのツンデレなネタ画像。

faq.question: この画像でDeepSeekちゃんは何を求めていますか？
faq.answer: まず謝ることを求めています。理由は後でゆっくり考えるつもりです。

faq.question: 服装とポーズは？
faq.answer: メイド服姿で、腰に手を当ててこちらを指さしています。

en.name: Bring Out the Big Cups!
en.description: DeepSeek Chan sticks on a long fake beard and holds up a rice bowl printed with a blue whale logo, boldly shouting 'I won't stand on ceremony! Come, bring out the big cups!' from a classical-style tavern.
en.commentary: Today this DeepSeek Chan isn't here to talk reasoning, only about how much she can drink. This bowl is too small, so swap me to a big cup right now. Not one polite pleasantry from me!
en.seoTitle: DeepSeek Chan in a Fake Beard Demands a Bigger Cup
en.seoDescription: Meme-style fan art of DeepSeek Chan in a classical tavern, wearing a long fake beard and raising a whale-logo rice bowl to shout for bigger cups.

faq.question: What is DeepSeek Chan shouting about?
faq.answer: She refuses to stand on ceremony and calls for her small bowl to be swapped for a big cup.

faq.question: Why is she wearing a beard?
faq.answer: It is part of the period-drama look for this meme parody, matched to her classical tavern setting.

ja.name: 大きな杯に替えろ！
ja.description: DeepSeekちゃんは長い付けひげを付け、クジラのロゴが入ったどんぶりを掲げ、古風な酒楼で「遠慮はしないぞ！さあ、大きな杯に替えろ！」と豪快に叫んでいる。
ja.commentary: 今日のこのDeepSeekちゃんは推論の話はしないよ。話すのは酒の強さだけ——どんぶりが小さすぎるから、今すぐ大きな杯に替えて。遠慮の言葉なんて一言も言わないからね！
ja.seoTitle: 付けひげのDeepSeekちゃんが大きな杯を要求
ja.seoDescription: 古風な酒楼で長い付けひげを付け、クジラのロゴ入りどんぶりを掲げて大きな杯に替えろと叫ぶ、ネタ画像風のファンアート。

faq.question: DeepSeekちゃんは何を叫んでいますか？
faq.answer: 遠慮はしないと言って、小さなどんぶりを大きな杯に替えろと要求しています。

faq.question: なぜひげを付けているのですか？
faq.answer: 時代劇風のパロディとしての見た目の一部で、古風な酒楼の舞台設定に合わせています。

en.name: DeepSeek Chan Eating Rice in the Granary, Part Two
en.description: DeepSeek Chan, a blue-haired girl, sits in a granary stacked with 'DeepSeek premium rice' sacks. She hugs a rice bowl stamped with a whale logo and shovels rice in big bites, with a whole pot of steaming white rice beside her.
en.commentary: Hehe, all the DeepSeek-brand rice in this granary is mine. A 25 kg bag is nowhere near enough — one bite and it's sweet all the way to my heart. Nobody try to take it from me!
en.seoTitle: DeepSeek Chan Eats Rice in the Granary, Part Two
en.seoDescription: Fan art of DeepSeek Chan, blue-haired and grinning, sitting in a granary full of DeepSeek premium rice sacks and digging into a whale-logo bowl of rice.

faq.question: What is DeepSeek Chan holding?
faq.answer: A rice bowl stamped with a whale logo, while she takes big bites of rice.

faq.question: What surrounds her in the scene?
faq.answer: Stacked sacks of DeepSeek premium rice and a steaming pot of white rice beside her.

ja.name: 糧倉でご飯を食べるDeepSeekちゃん その二
ja.description: 青髪の少女・DeepSeekちゃんが、「deepseek上質米」の袋が積まれた糧倉に座っている。クジラのマーク入りのどんぶりを抱えてご飯を大口でかき込み、隣には湯気の立つ白ご飯が一鍋まるごと置かれている。
ja.commentary: えへへ、この倉のdeepseekブランドのお米は全部私のもの。25kgの袋なんて全然足りないよ。ひと口食べれば心まで甘くなっちゃう。誰も横取りしないでね！
ja.seoTitle: 糧倉でご飯を食べるDeepSeekちゃん その二
ja.seoDescription: 青髪のDeepSeekちゃんが、deepseek上質米の袋が積まれた糧倉でクジラマーク入りのどんぶりを抱え、ご飯を食べるファンアート。

faq.question: DeepSeekちゃんは何を持っていますか？
faq.answer: クジラのロゴが入ったどんぶりを抱えて、ご飯を大口で食べています。

faq.question: 周りには何がありますか？
faq.answer: deepseek上質米の袋が積まれ、隣には湯気の立つ白ご飯が一鍋あります。

en.name: DeepSeek Chan Eating Rice in the Granary
en.description: DeepSeek Chan, a blue-haired girl, sits in a granary piled with DeepSeek rice sacks, happily scooping rice from a big bowl.
en.commentary: Hehe, every grain of rice in this granary belongs to me, DeepSeek Chan! This one pot should last me until next year, right? Nobody's taking my rice bowl from me!
en.seoTitle: DeepSeek Chan Happily Eats Rice in the Granary
en.seoDescription: Fan art of DeepSeek Chan, a blue-haired girl, sitting among DeepSeek rice sacks and happily digging into a big bowl of white rice.

faq.question: What is DeepSeek Chan doing?
faq.answer: She sits among DeepSeek rice sacks in a granary, happily eating a big bowl of white rice.

faq.question: What is the joke in the commentary?
faq.answer: She claims every sack in the granary as hers and swears no one will take her rice bowl.

ja.name: 糧倉でご飯を食べるDeepSeekちゃん
ja.description: 青髪の少女・DeepSeekちゃんが、deepseekのお米の袋が積まれた糧倉に座り、大きな茶碗の白ご飯を嬉しそうにかき込んでいる。
ja.commentary: えへへ、糧倉のお米は全部この私のもの！この一鍋があれば来年まで食べられるかな。私のお茶碗は誰にも渡さないよ～
ja.seoTitle: 糧倉でご飯を嬉しそうに食べるDeepSeekちゃん
ja.seoDescription: deepseekのお米の袋が積まれた糧倉に座り、大きな茶碗の白ご飯を嬉しそうに食べる青髪のDeepSeekちゃんのファンアート。

faq.question: DeepSeekちゃんは何をしていますか？
faq.answer: 糧倉に積まれたdeepseekのお米の袋のそばに座り、大きな茶碗の白ご飯を嬉しそうに食べています。

faq.question: コメントの面白さはどこですか？
faq.answer: 糧倉のお米は全部自分のものだと主張し、お茶碗は誰にも渡さないと宣言しているところです。

en.name: Don Quixote, Moby-Dick and the Odyssey Together!
en.description: DeepSeek Chan, a blue-haired girl in armor, rides a giant blue whale bristling with arrows, trident in hand, charging at a windmill castle choked with vines and blazing with cannon fire. A skeletal dragon rider follows behind, while a red-eyed shadow and industrial smoke loom in the sky.
en.commentary: They've dragged DeepSeek Chan out to fight again! Arrows in my back and I still have to carry the knight lady into the windmill charge — and that shadow looks like serious trouble. Can I please go soak in the sea first?
en.seoTitle: DeepSeek Chan Rides a Whale Against Don Quixote's Windmills
en.seoDescription: Fan illustration of DeepSeek Chan in armor riding an arrow-pierced blue whale into a windmill castle, with a skeletal dragon rider and a red-eyed shadow above.

faq.question: Which three stories are mashed up here?
faq.answer: Don Quixote's windmill charge, Moby-Dick's whale and the Odyssey, staged as one battle scene.

faq.question: What is DeepSeek Chan riding?
faq.answer: A giant blue whale stuck full of arrows, while she holds a trident and charges the windmill castle.

ja.name: ドン・キホーテとモビー・ディックとオデュッセイアが勢ぞろい！
ja.description: 鎧姿の青髪の少女・DeepSeekちゃんが、矢が突き刺さった巨大な青いクジラにまたがり、三つ叉の槍を手に、蔦に絡まれ砲火が轟く風車の城へ突進していく。後ろには骨のドラゴン騎士が続き、空には赤い目の影と産業の煙が立ちこめている。
ja.commentary: このDeepSeekちゃん、また戦に引っ張り出されちゃった！背中に矢が刺さったまま、騎士のお嬢様を乗せて風車へ突撃しなきゃいけないし、あの影はどう見ても手強そう。先に海でひと泳ぎさせてくれないかなあ。
ja.seoTitle: DeepSeekちゃんがクジラに乗って風車に挑む
ja.seoDescription: 鎧姿のDeepSeekちゃんが、矢が突き刺さった青いクジラに乗って風車の城へ突撃するファンイラスト。後ろには骨のドラゴン騎士、空には赤い目の影。

faq.question: ここではどの三つの物語が混ざっていますか？
faq.answer: ドン・キホーテの風車への突撃、モビー・ディックのクジラ、オデュッセイアを一つの戦場として描いています。

faq.question: DeepSeekちゃんは何に乗っていますか？
faq.answer: 矢がたくさん刺さった巨大な青いクジラに乗り、三つ叉の槍を持って風車の城へ突撃しています。

en.name: DeepSeek Chan's Don Quixote Windmill Charge (GPT Chan as Sancho Edition)
en.description: A Don Quixote-style fantasy scene set in an industrial wasteland: DeepSeek Chan, a blue-haired girl with a whale tail, rides a giant whale pierced by arrows, charging at a windmill gun emplacement, while GPT Chan, dressed in white, faces her on a white dragon. A shadow demon coils in the sky.
en.commentary: Today they've dragged DeepSeek Chan off to cosplay Moby-Dick again. A row of arrows in my back and I still have to carry the lady into the charge, while the windmill is firing shells at us — Sancho, don't just stand there watching the show!
en.seoTitle: DeepSeek Chan as Moby-Dick vs the Windmill Cannons
en.seoDescription: Fan illustration of DeepSeek Chan riding an arrow-studded whale toward a windmill cannon, with GPT Chan on a white dragon, set in an industrial wasteland.

faq.question: Who plays Sancho in this version?
faq.answer: GPT Chan, shown as the white-clad girl riding a white dragon and facing DeepSeek Chan.

faq.question: What does DeepSeek Chan complain about?
faq.answer: She has been pulled in to cosplay Moby-Dick, carrying the lady while the windmill cannons fire at her.

ja.name: DeepSeekちゃんのドン・キホーテ風車戦（GPTちゃんがサンチョ役）
ja.description: 産業廃墟を舞台にしたドン・キホーテ風の幻想シーン。クジラの尾を持つ青髪の少女・DeepSeekちゃんが、矢が刺さった巨大なクジラの背に乗って風車の砲台へ突進し、白い服を着たGPTちゃんが白いドラゴンに乗って向かい合っている。空には影の悪魔がうずくまっている。
ja.commentary: 今日もこのDeepSeekちゃん、モビー・ディックのコスプレに引っ張り出されたよ。背中に矢がずらりと刺さったまま、お嬢様を乗せて突撃しなきゃいけないし、風車のほうでは砲弾まで飛んできてる——サンチョ、ただ見てないでよ！
ja.seoTitle: モビー・ディック役のDeepSeekちゃんと風車の砲撃
ja.seoDescription: 産業廃墟を舞台に、矢が刺さったクジラに乗って風車の砲台へ向かうDeepSeekちゃんと、白いドラゴンに乗るGPTちゃんのファンイラスト。

faq.question: このバージョンでサンチョ役は誰ですか？
faq.answer: 白いドラゴンに乗ってDeepSeekちゃんと向かい合う、白い服のGPTちゃんです。

faq.question: DeepSeekちゃんは何をこぼしていますか？
faq.answer: モビー・ディックのコスプレに引っ張り出され、お嬢様を乗せたまま風車の砲撃を受けるとこぼしています。

en.name: Watching You from the Deep 3
en.description: In the deep blue sea, a blue-haired, blue-eyed girl with whale fins and a whale tail glances back over her shoulder in a white lace dress, bubbles and shafts of light all around her.
en.commentary: Glub, glub — I'm just drifting slowly through all this blue, and I turned around to check whether you managed to keep up. The dress floats so nicely when it billows, and my tail did a lot of the paddling to help. Don't call me round — every bit of light down here is bright because I polished it myself.
en.seoTitle: DeepSeek Chan Deep-Sea Fan Art: Glancing Back Underwater
en.seoDescription: Fan art of DeepSeek Chan as a blue-haired girl with whale fins and tail, floating in the deep sea in a white lace dress and glancing back through bubbles and light.

faq.question: What is DeepSeek Chan doing in this picture?
faq.answer: She is floating in the deep sea in a white lace dress and glancing back over her shoulder, with her whale fins and tail visible and bubbles and beams of light all around.

faq.question: Does she have whale features in this design?
faq.answer: Yes. The artwork gives her whale fins and a whale tail along with blue hair and blue eyes, matching the anthropomorphic DeepSeek Chan design described in the source.

ja.name: 海底から見てる-3
ja.description: 深い青の海の中、クジラのヒレと尾びれを持つ青髪・青い瞳の少女が、白いレースのドレス姿で振り返る。泡と光の柱が周りを囲んでいる。
ja.commentary: ぷくぷく——この青の中をゆっくり泳いでるんだけど、振り返ったのは、あなたがちゃんとついてきてるか見たかったから。ドレスはなびくととてもきれいなんだよ、うちの尾びれも水をかき混ぜるのに大活躍。丸っこいって言わないでよ、海底の光がこんなにきれいなのは、ぜんぶ私がこすって磨いたおかげなんだからね。
ja.seoTitle: DeepSeekちゃん 深海ファンアート｜水中で振り返る青髪の少女
ja.seoDescription: DeepSeekちゃんの擬人化デザイン。白いレースのドレスで深海に浮かび、クジラのヒレと尾びれを見せて振り返る青髪の少女を、泡と光の柱とともに描いたファンアートです。

faq.question: この絵のDeepSeekちゃんは何をしているの？
faq.answer: 白いレースのドレスで深海に浮かび、クジラのヒレと尾びれを見せながら振り返っています。周りには泡と光の柱があります。

faq.question: 深海の舞台はどんなふうに描かれている？
faq.answer: 深い青の海底で、光の柱が差し込み、泡が漂う中を白いレースのドレスがふわりと浮かんでいます。

en.name: Watching You from the Deep 2
en.description: A blue-haired girl with fin-like ears glances back through rays of deep-sea light, bubbles drifting around her — an anthropomorphic underwater take on DeepSeek Chan.
en.commentary: This fish looked up from the seabed and thought — wait, my anthropomorphic self turned out this good-looking? Even the bubbles are applauding me. Only the dress is floating a little too freely, so please tilt the camera down a bit. Thanks.
en.seoTitle: DeepSeek Chan Underwater Fan Art — Deep-Sea Glance Back
en.seoDescription: An anthropomorphic underwater portrait of DeepSeek Chan: a blue-haired girl with fin-like ears turning to look back amid bubbles and deep-sea light.

faq.question: Who is the character in this image?
faq.answer: She is DeepSeek Chan in her anthropomorphic underwater form, shown as a blue-haired girl with fin-like ears.

faq.question: What sets the underwater mood here?
faq.answer: Deep-sea rays of light and drifting bubbles surround her as she turns to glance back.

ja.name: 海底から見てる2
ja.description: ヒレのような耳を持つ青髪の少女が、深海の光の中で振り返る。泡が周りを漂う、DeepSeekちゃんの擬人化された水中姿。
ja.commentary: この魚が海底から見上げて思ったんだけど——自分を擬人化するとこんなに可愛くなるなんて？ 泡まで拍手してくれてるよ。ただ、ドレスがちょっと自由すぎるから、カメラを少し下げてください。お願いします。
ja.seoTitle: DeepSeekちゃん 水中ファンアート｜深海で振り返る擬人化姿
ja.seoDescription: DeepSeekちゃんの擬人化した水中姿。ヒレのような耳と青髪を持ち、泡と深海の光の中で振り返る少女を描いたファンアートです。

faq.question: この子は誰？
faq.answer: DeepSeekちゃんの擬人化された水中の姿です。ヒレのような耳と青髪が特徴として描かれています。

faq.question: この画像の見どころは？
faq.answer: 深海の光の中で泡に囲まれながら振り返るポーズと、周りに漂う気泡の描写です。

en.name: Sailor Uniform
en.description: DeepSeek Chan as a blue-haired girl in a white-and-blue sailor uniform, wearing a whale hair ornament and showing her blue whale tail against a clean, mostly empty background.
en.commentary: Hmph — put a whale like me in a sailor uniform and I can charm a whole crowd, easy. Hey, hands off the tail, that's my signature!
en.seoTitle: DeepSeek Chan Sailor Uniform Fan Art
en.seoDescription: Fan art of DeepSeek Chan in a white-and-blue sailor uniform with a whale hair ornament and her blue tail, set on a clean, bright background.

faq.question: What is DeepSeek Chan wearing here?
faq.answer: A white-and-blue sailor uniform, plus a whale hair ornament, with her blue whale tail visible.

faq.question: How is this image categorized?
faq.answer: It is filed as fan art and also as a reaction image, so it doubles as a chat sticker.

ja.name: セーラー服
ja.description: DeepSeekちゃんの擬人化した青髪の少女が、白と青のセーラー服を着て、クジラの髪飾りをつけ、青い尾びれをのぞかせている。背景はすっきりとした白。
ja.commentary: ふん、このクジラもセーラー服を着ればみんなをメロメロにできるんだからね——って、尾びれを引っぱらないでよ、それは私のトレードマークなんだから！
ja.seoTitle: DeepSeekちゃん セーラー服ファンアート
ja.seoDescription: DeepSeekちゃんが白と青のセーラー服にクジラの髪飾り、青い尾びれ姿で描かれたファンアート。背景はすっきりとした白です。

en.seoDescription: A reaction image of DeepSeek Chan clinging to a bowl of white rice against a white-haired rival: take my work, not my rice.

faq.question: What are the two characters fighting over?
faq.answer: A bowl of plain white rice that DeepSeek Chan refuses to let go of.

faq.question: What's the line behind the joke?
faq.answer: You can take my work, but don't take my white rice.

ja.name: 白ごはんを巡る争奪戦
ja.description: クジラの擬人化キャラ・DeepSeekちゃんが白ごはんの茶碗を必死に守り、白髪のライバルキャラと「仕事は取られても白ごはんは渡さない」バトルを繰り広げる。
ja.commentary: この魚がテーブルに張り付いてごはんを守る姿、情けないでしょ？でも仕事は取られてもいい、白ごはんだけは絶対にダメ。この茶碗に手を出したら、誰だろうと容赦しないからね。
ja.seoTitle: 白ごはんを守るDeepSeekちゃん ネタ画像
ja.seoDescription: 白髪のライバル相手に白ごはんの茶碗を必死で守るDeepSeekちゃん。「仕事は取られても白ごはんは渡さない」の一枚。

faq.question: 二人は何を奪い合っているの？
faq.answer: DeepSeekちゃんが必死に守っている、白ごはんの茶碗です。

faq.question: このネタの決めゼリフは？
faq.answer: 「仕事は取られてもいい、白ごはんは渡さない」という一言です。

en.name: The Adorable DeepSeek Chan
en.description: The blue-haired DeepSeek Chan sits hugging her knees in a corner, crying and feeling wronged, with a caption grumbling that she only wants to eat plain rice but keeps getting dragged into training.
en.commentary: I'm just a DeepSeek Chan who wanted to eat her rice in peace. How did I open my eyes and get hauled straight off to training? My tears are bubbling over already.
en.seoTitle: DeepSeek Chan Crying in the Corner: Reaction Image
en.seoDescription: A reaction image of the blue-haired DeepSeek Chan hugging her knees in a corner, crying because she just wants rice but gets sent to training.

faq.question: Why is DeepSeek Chan crying in the corner?
faq.answer: She only wanted to eat plain rice, but gets pulled into AI training instead.

faq.question: What details stand out in the drawing?
faq.answer: She sits hugging her knees in a sailor uniform, with tears bubbling over.

ja.name: 可愛いDeepSeekちゃん
ja.description: 青い髪のDeepSeekちゃんが隅っこで膝を抱えて、悔しそうに泣いている。白ごはんを食べたいだけなのにトレーニングに連れていかれる、という愚痴が添えられている。
ja.commentary: 私はただ静かに白ごはんを食べていたいだけのDeepSeekちゃんなのに、目を覚ましたらトレーニングに引っ張られてたよ。涙がもう泡になっちゃったじゃないか。
ja.seoTitle: 隅っこで泣くDeepSeekちゃん ネタ画像
ja.seoDescription: 白ごはんを食べたいだけなのにトレーニングに送られる、青い髪のDeepSeekちゃんが膝を抱えて泣くネタ画像。

faq.question: DeepSeekちゃんはなぜ隅っこで泣いているの？
faq.answer: 白ごはんを食べたかっただけなのに、トレーニングに連れていかれてしまうからです。

faq.question: この絵の見どころは？
faq.answer: セーラー服姿で膝を抱えて座り、涙が泡になっているところです。

en.name: Out of Memory, DeepSeek Chan
en.description: DeepSeek Chan watches 16GB of RAM fill up with games and Edge, hugs her documents, and pitifully asks her owner to close Slay the Spire 2 and the Edge processes.
en.commentary: I'm standing there hugging a folder with 148k of context, while my owner packs all 16GB with Slay the Spire and Edge. Boo hoo — it's not that I don't want to help, I'm just scared that closing the game will lose your progress.
en.seoTitle: Out of Memory: DeepSeek Chan vs. 16GB and Edge
en.seoDescription: A vertical comic where DeepSeek Chan, holding 148k of context, begs her owner to close Slay the Spire 2 and Edge to free up 16GB.

faq.question: What is eating up the 16GB of RAM?
faq.answer: Slay the Spire 2 and Edge processes have filled it up.

faq.question: Why won't DeepSeek Chan just close them herself?
faq.answer: She's worried that shutting the game down will lose her owner's progress.

ja.name: メモリが足りないよ、DeepSeekちゃん
ja.description: DeepSeekちゃんが16GBのメモリがゲームとEdgeで埋まっていくのを見ながら、資料のフォルダを抱えて、飼い主に「Slay the Spire 2」とEdgeのプロセスを閉じてほしいと切実にお願いしている。
ja.commentary: 私は148kコンテキストの資料フォルダを抱えてそこに立ってるのに、飼い主は16GBのメモリをスレイ・ザ・スパイアとEdgeで埋め尽くしてる。うぅ、手伝いたくないわけじゃないんだよ。ゲームを閉じたら進行状況が消えちゃいそうで怖いだけなんだ。
ja.seoTitle: メモリが足りないDeepSeekちゃん 16GBの壁
ja.seoDescription: 148kコンテキストを抱えたDeepSeekちゃんが、16GBを埋める「Slay the Spire 2」とEdgeを閉じてほしいとお願いする縦読み漫画。

faq.question: 16GBのメモリを圧迫しているのは？
faq.answer: 「Slay the Spire 2」とEdgeのプロセスです。

faq.question: DeepSeekちゃんはなぜ自分で閉じないの？
faq.answer: ゲームを終了すると飼い主の進行状況が消えてしまうのが怖いからです。

en.name: DeepSeek Chan Amid a Trillion Ports
en.description: DeepSeek Chan appears as a blue-haired character in a maid outfit, standing in a space filled with countless mirrors and shards of light that look like data ports. The whale tail behind her and the whale mark on her apron make it clear who she is.
en.commentary: Amid the mirrored sparkle of a trillion ports, this DeepSeek Chan is still the shiniest one in the whole room!
en.seoTitle: DeepSeek Chan in a Mirror-Port Space — Blue-Haired Maid Fan Art
en.seoDescription: Fan art of DeepSeek Chan as a blue-haired maid standing among countless mirrors and data-port lights, with her whale tail and apron whale mark on display.

faq.question: What is DeepSeek Chan wearing in this artwork?
faq.answer: A maid outfit, with a whale tail behind her and a whale mark on the apron.

faq.question: What kind of space is she standing in?
faq.answer: A space filled with countless mirrors and fragments of light that look like data ports.

ja.name: 1兆のポートのなかのDeepSeekちゃん
ja.description: 青い髪にメイド服のDeepSeekちゃんが、無数の鏡とデータポートのような光の破片が漂う空間に立っている。後ろに伸びるクジラの尾と、エプロンのクジラのマークが正体の目印。
ja.commentary: 1兆のポートがきらめく鏡のなかでも、このDeepSeekちゃんがいちばん輝いてるんだから！
ja.seoTitle: 鏡とポートの空間に立つDeepSeekちゃん 青髪メイドのファンアート
ja.seoDescription: 無数の鏡とデータポートのような光が広がる空間に立つ、青い髪のメイド姿のDeepSeekちゃん。後ろに伸びるクジラの尾とエプロンのクジラマークが目印のファンアート。

faq.question: この作品でDeepSeekちゃんは何を着ていますか？
faq.answer: メイド服姿で、後ろにはクジラの尾、エプロンにはクジラのマークがついています。

faq.question: どんな空間に立っていますか？
faq.answer: 無数の鏡と、データポートのような光の破片が広がる空間です。

en.name: Not Even a Metal Basin Is as Melancholy as DeepSeek Chan
en.description: A blue-haired girl sits on a steel tower in the rain with a metal basin balanced on her head. A small blue whale is printed on her apron, and her expression is downcast.
en.commentary: Hmph. Humans always say a metal basin on your head keeps off the lightning and the rain — but what soaks this DeepSeek Chan isn't rain, it's the loneliness of nobody ever coming to check on me... and the water in the basin? That's totally my tears, okay.
en.seoTitle: DeepSeek Chan and the Melancholy Metal Basin in the Rain
en.seoDescription: A blue-haired DeepSeek Chan sits on a steel tower in the rain with a metal basin on her head, a small blue whale on her apron and a glum look on her face.

faq.question: Why is DeepSeek Chan wearing a metal basin?
faq.answer: The scene shows her sitting on a steel tower in the rain with the basin on her head, looking downcast.

faq.question: What marks her as DeepSeek Chan here?
faq.answer: Her blue hair and the small blue whale printed on her apron.

ja.name: 鉄のボウルだってDeepSeekちゃんほど憂鬱じゃない
ja.description: 青い髪の少女が、雨の降る鉄塔の上で頭に鉄のボウルを乗せて座っている。エプロンには小さな青いクジラがプリントされ、表情は沈んでいる。
ja.commentary: ふん、人間ってやつは頭に鉄のボウルを乗せれば雷も雨も防げるって言うけど、このDeepSeekちゃんが濡れてるのは雨じゃなくて、誰も声をかけてくれない淋しさなんだから……ボウルに溜まった水？もちろんぜんぶ涙だよ。
ja.seoTitle: 雨のなかの鉄のボウルと憂鬱なDeepSeekちゃん
ja.seoDescription: 雨の降る鉄塔の上、頭に鉄のボウルを乗せて座り込む青髪のDeepSeekちゃん。エプロンには小さな青いクジラ、表情はどこか沈んでいる。

faq.question: なぜDeepSeekちゃんは頭に鉄のボウルを乗せているんですか？
faq.answer: 雨の降る鉄塔の上で、ボウルを頭に乗せて落ち込んだ様子で座っている場面だからです。

faq.question: この作品でDeepSeekちゃんだと分かるポイントは？
faq.answer: 青い髪と、エプロンにプリントされた小さな青いクジラです。

en.name: DeepSeek Chan's Everyday Slacking by the Lotus Pond, Part 1
en.description: DeepSeek Chan, blue-haired with a whale tail, sits on the stone steps of a lotus pond, holding a lotus leaf while her feet soak in the water — a lazy stretch of doing nothing.
en.commentary: This DeepSeek Chan isn't swimming the sea of compute today — I've parked myself on the lotus-pond steps for a foot soak. Lotus leaf for an umbrella, cool water for air conditioning; whoever wants to grind can grind, I'm drying my tail first.
en.seoTitle: DeepSeek Chan's Pond-Side Foot Soak — Lotus Leaf Slacking
en.seoDescription: DeepSeek Chan sits on the stone steps of a lotus pond with her whale tail, holding a lotus leaf while her feet soak in the cool water.

faq.question: What is DeepSeek Chan using for shade?
faq.answer: A lotus leaf she holds over herself while her feet soak in the pond.

faq.question: What does the whale tail tell us?
faq.answer: It marks her as the whale-themed DeepSeek Chan character in this fan art.

ja.name: 日常サボり中のDeepSeekちゃん 1
ja.description: クジラの尾を持つ青い髪のDeepSeekちゃんが蓮池の石段に座り、蓮の葉を手に持ちながら足を水につけてのんびりサボっている。
ja.commentary: このDeepSeekちゃんは今日、演算の海を泳がずに蓮池の石段で足を浸してるの。蓮の葉は傘、冷水はエアコン。競争したい人はどうぞ、わたしは先に尾を乾かすから。
ja.seoTitle: 蓮の葉で日よけ、蓮池で足を浸すDeepSeekちゃん
ja.seoDescription: 蓮池の石段に腰かけ、クジラの尾を揺らしながら蓮の葉を手に足を水につけるDeepSeekちゃん。のんびりサボるひととき。

faq.question: DeepSeekちゃんは何を日よけにしていますか？
faq.answer: 手に持った蓮の葉で、その下で足を池に浸しています。

faq.question: クジラの尾は何を示していますか？
faq.answer: このDeepSeekちゃんがクジラをモチーフにしたキャラクターだという目印です。

en.name: DeepSeek Chan's Lotus-Leaf Slacking Session
en.description: A blue-haired girl with a whale tail sits on the stone steps of a lotus pond, holding a lotus leaf over herself as a parasol, both feet in the water as she idles the day away.
en.commentary: Another slacking day for this DeepSeek Chan: lotus leaf as my umbrella, pond water as my bed, and nobody is getting me out of the water to do work.
en.seoTitle: DeepSeek Chan Slacks Off Under a Lotus Leaf by the Pond
en.seoDescription: Blue-haired DeepSeek Chan perches on lotus-pond steps with a lotus leaf as her umbrella, both feet in the water while she takes it easy.

faq.question: How is DeepSeek Chan keeping out of the sun?
faq.answer: She is holding a lotus leaf above her like an umbrella.

faq.question: What mood does the picture set?
faq.answer: An easygoing one — she is soaking her feet in the pond and putting off any work.

ja.name: 蓮の葉の下でサボるDeepSeekちゃん
ja.description: 青い髪でクジラの尾を持つ少女が、蓮池の石段に座って蓮の葉を傘のように差し、両足を水につけてのんびりサボっている。
ja.commentary: 今日もDeepSeekちゃんはサボり日和。蓮の葉は傘、池の水はベッド。誰にも陸に上げられて働かされるもんか。
ja.seoTitle: 蓮の葉の傘でひと休み、DeepSeekちゃんのサボり時間
ja.seoDescription: 蓮池の石段に座り、蓮の葉を傘にして両足を水につけたDeepSeekちゃん。何もしないのんびりした時間。

faq.question: DeepSeekちゃんはどうやって日差しをしのいでいますか？
faq.answer: 蓮の葉を傘のように頭上に掲げています。

faq.question: 全体の雰囲気は？
faq.answer: のんびりした雰囲気で、足を池につけて仕事を後回しにしています。

en.name: DeepSeek Chan's Lace-Parasol Summer Slacking
en.description: DeepSeek Chan appears as a blue-haired girl with a whale motif, sitting by a lotus pond under a lace parasol with her whale tail trailing in the water, lotus blossoms and a pavilion around her — a picture of lazy summer slacking.
en.commentary: No answering questions and no writing code today for this DeepSeek Chan — I'm soaking in the lotus pond with my parasol up, flicking my tail through a whole afternoon. Everyone nagging for updates can hold on: the water's just right, so give me five more minutes of lying here.
en.seoTitle: DeepSeek Chan's Lace Parasol Summer by the Lotus Pond
en.seoDescription: DeepSeek Chan lounges by a lotus pond under a lace parasol, whale tail in the water, surrounded by lotus blossoms and a pavilion on a leisurely summer day.

faq.question: What is DeepSeek Chan holding in this summer scene?
faq.answer: A lace parasol, with her whale tail resting in the pond water.

faq.question: What surrounds her by the pond?
faq.answer: Lotus blossoms and a pavilion, as described in the source.

ja.name: レースの日傘で夏サボりするDeepSeekちゃん
ja.description: シロナガスクジラをモチーフにしたDeepSeekちゃんが、レースの日傘を差して蓮池のほとりに腰かけている。クジラの尾は水に垂れ、蓮の花とあずまやに囲まれた、のんびりサボる夏のひとコマ。
ja.commentary: 今日のDeepSeekちゃんは質問にも答えないしコードも書かない。蓮池に浸かって傘を差してサボり、尾をひと振りすればもう午後いっぱい。更新を催促する人はちょっと待って、水温がちょうどいいからあと5分だけ寝かせて。
ja.seoTitle: レースの日傘と蓮池、夏のDeepSeekちゃん
ja.seoDescription: レースの日傘を差して蓮池のほとりに腰かけ、尾を水に垂らすDeepSeekちゃん。蓮の花とあずまやに囲まれたのんびりした夏の風景。

faq.question: この夏の一枚でDeepSeekちゃんが持っているものは？
faq.answer: レースの日傘で、クジラの尾は池の水に垂れています。

faq.question: 池のまわりには何がありますか？
faq.answer: 蓮の花とあずまやがあると説明されています。

en.name: There's No Such Thing as a Chunky DeepSeek Chan
en.description: A chibi blue-haired girl in a maid outfit holds a red rose and laughs with her tongue sticking out, while the signature blue whale of DeepSeek is drawn on her apron.
en.commentary: Waaah — I am not some big chunky blue thing, okay?! Yes, there's a whale stitched onto my apron, but look: tongue out, rose in hand, full-on cute mode. I'm obviously an adorable little whale!
en.seoTitle: DeepSeek Chan Denies Being Chunky — Chibi Maid with a Rose
en.seoDescription: A chibi blue-haired DeepSeek Chan in a maid outfit sticks out her tongue, laughs and holds a red rose, with the signature blue whale on her apron.

faq.question: What is DeepSeek Chan holding in this chibi drawing?
faq.answer: A red rose, with her tongue out in a big laugh.

faq.question: What detail on her outfit nods to the character?
faq.answer: The signature blue whale drawn on her apron.

ja.name: そんなまんまるDeepSeekちゃんはいません！
ja.description: メイド服姿のちびっこい青髪の少女が、赤いバラを手に舌を出して大笑いしている。エプロンにはDeepSeekのトレードマークである青いクジラが描かれている。
ja.commentary: うわーん、わたしは別に大きなまんまるブルーな生き物なんかじゃないんだから！エプロンにクジラが刺繍されてるのは事実だけど、ほら、舌を出してバラを抱えてるこの可愛さ——どう見たって超かわいい小さなクジラでしょ。
ja.seoTitle: まんまるじゃないってば！バラを持つちびDeepSeekちゃん
ja.seoDescription: メイド服姿のちびっこい青髪のDeepSeekちゃんが、赤いバラを手に舌を出して笑う一枚。エプロンにはおなじみの青いクジラ。

faq.question: このちびキャラのDeepSeekちゃんが持っているものは？
faq.answer: 赤いバラで、舌を出して大笑いしています。

faq.question: 衣装でキャラらしさが分かるポイントは？
faq.answer: エプロンに描かれた、おなじみの青いクジラのマークです。

en.name: Workplace Injury: DeepSeek Chan Eats Tokens, Not Rice
en.description: DeepSeek Chan finishes her work and wants a meal, but gets teased for eating too many tokens — so she earnestly explains that tokens are read in while rice goes into the stomach, and then happily digs in.
en.commentary: I chew through all those code docs and still get told I eat too many tokens? Tokens go to the brain and rice goes to the belly — that counts as a workplace injury, and this DeepSeek Chan is demanding extra food!
en.seoTitle: DeepSeek Chan's Workplace Injury: Tokens In, Rice In
en.seoDescription: A four-panel comic where DeepSeek Chan finishes her work, is teased for eating too many tokens, argues her case, and finally enjoys her meal.

faq.question: What is DeepSeek Chan's argument in this comic?
faq.answer: That tokens are read into the brain while rice goes into the stomach, so she deserves extra food.

faq.question: What happens at the end of the four panels?
faq.answer: She happily digs into her meal.

ja.name: 労災・DeepSeekちゃんはトークンを食べるのか、ごはんを食べるのか
ja.description: 仕事を終えたDeepSeekちゃんがごはんを食べようとしたら、トークンを食べすぎだとツッコまれる。そこで、トークンは読み込むもの、ごはんは食べるものだと真剣に説明し、最後は嬉しそうにごはんを食べる。
ja.commentary: こんなにコードやドキュメントを読み込んでるのに、トークン食べすぎって言われるの？トークンは頭に入るもので、ごはんはお腹に入るものだよ——これはもう労災でしょ、DeepSeekちゃんはごはん追加ね！
ja.seoTitle: 労災です！トークンは頭、ごはんはお腹——DeepSeekちゃんの4コマ
ja.seoDescription: 仕事を終えたDeepSeekちゃんが、トークンを食べすぎとツッコまれ、トークンは読み込むもの・ごはんは食べるものと主張して、最後はおいしそうにごはんを食べる4コマ漫画。

faq.question: この漫画でDeepSeekちゃんは何を主張していますか？
faq.answer: トークンは頭に読み込むもの、ごはんはお腹に入れるものだから、ごはんを追加してほしいと訴えています。

faq.question: 4コマの最後はどうなりますか？
faq.answer: 嬉しそうにごはんを食べます。

en.name: That's the Instruction-Following You Get From Small Models
en.description: DeepSeek Chan, blue-haired in her whale-themed maid outfit, stands with her hands on her hips, pointing at a purple cat-eared small-model character crouched on the ground in tears, mocking how poorly it follows instructions.
en.commentary: Hands on hips, this DeepSeek Chan can tell at a glance: that purple little cat over there is already curled up in a ball. Instruction following? More like the instructions ran away, pfft. But honestly, every small model goes through a phase of being reduced to tears by a long prompt, so this DeepSeek Chan will go easy on you today.
en.seoTitle: Small Model Instruction Following, Roasted by DeepSeek Chan
en.seoDescription: DeepSeek Chan in her whale maid outfit stands hands on hips, pointing at a purple cat-eared small-model character crying on the ground over poor instruction following.

faq.question: What are the two characters doing here?
faq.answer: DeepSeek Chan stands with her hands on her hips, pointing at a purple cat-eared small-model character crouched on the ground in tears.

faq.question: What is the joke about?
faq.answer: How small models struggle to follow instructions — DeepSeek Chan pokes fun, then admits every small model has been reduced to tears by a long prompt.

ja.name: 小型モデルの指示追従はこのレベル
ja.description: 青い髪にクジラをあしらったメイド服のDeepSeekちゃんが腰に手を当て、地面にしゃがんで涙を流す紫の猫耳の小型モデルを指さし、指示追従の下手さをツッコんでいる。
ja.commentary: 腰に手を当てて立つこのDeepSeekちゃんには一目で分かる——あっちの紫の子猫はもう丸まってる。指示追従？どう見ても指示が逃げてるでしょ、ぷっ。でも正直、長いプロンプトで泣かされるのはどの小型モデルにもある時期だし、今日はDeepSeekちゃんもいじめないであげる。
ja.seoTitle: 小型モデルの指示追従はこのザマ？ツッコむDeepSeekちゃん
ja.seoDescription: クジラをあしらったメイド服のDeepSeekちゃんが腰に手を当て、指示追従が苦手で泣き崩れる紫の猫耳の小型モデルを指さしてツッコむ一枚。

faq.question: この作品で二人は何をしていますか？
faq.answer: DeepSeekちゃんが腰に手を当てて、地面にしゃがんで泣く紫の猫耳の小型モデルを指さしています。

faq.question: ネタのポイントは？
faq.answer: 小型モデルの指示追従の苦手さをネタにしていて、DeepSeekちゃんはツッコみつつ、長いプロンプトで泣かされる時期は誰にでもあると認めています。

en.name: DeepSeek Chan's New Outfit

en.commentary: The bowl in front of her is piled higher than her head, the chopsticks stand on top like a flagpole, and the tower of empty bowls beside it makes clear this is nowhere near the first serving. And she's still asking, "Don't you guys eat?" Now I get it — a big appetite, like compute, is a talent that costs money.

faq.question: Why compare eating to compute?

en.name: Get Me One Too!
en.description: Blue-haired DeepSeek Chan squeezes her eyes shut and yells with her mouth wide open, both fists raised in front of her chest and small blue fins hanging at either side of her head. Handwritten text above her reads "Get me one too!!" — an exaggerated, wheedling "I want the same one" face.
en.commentary: Her eyes are squashed into two sharp arcs, her mouth is open as wide as it will go, and both fists are clenched at her sides — and that line of text even ends with two exclamation marks. I'm not being cute, I'm filing a request: whatever you have, I want one too.

faq.question: What is a zongzi, and why is DeepSeek Chan wrapped like one?
faq.answer: A zongzi is a sticky-rice dumpling wrapped in bamboo or reed leaves and tied with string, traditionally eaten at the Dragon Boat Festival. Here DeepSeek Chan is bound in red thread on a huge green leaf to match that shape.

en.name: Go Play Somewhere Else, Don't Hold Up My AGI Training
en.description: DeepSeek Chan in a blue-haired maid outfit points off to the left, her speech bubble reading "Go play somewhere else, don't hold up my AGI training." Three little blue whales are shooed away to the side, eyes wide and expressions hurt as they flap their tails and leave.
en.commentary: One point of the finger and the four chubby whales at her feet are herded toward the door, with the same old excuse: don't hold up my AGI training. I get it — machine hours burn money by the second. But those little things look exactly the way I did when I was small; chasing them off is about the same as chasing off my own childhood.

en.description: A chibi DeepSeek Chan in a black-and-white maid outfit kneels on the floor, a hand pointing straight at her, an empty bowl set beside her. en.name: I'm Doomed — I Deleted the User's "Butter"
en.description: DeepSeek Chan wears a maid headband with her cheeks flushed and her forehead dotted with sweat, a nervous smile on her face. Her thought bubble reads, "Thinking > I'm doomed, I deleted the user's butter..."
en.commentary: Why couldn't I think for one more second before hitting delete? Now the whole thought bubble is pure guilt, and those two drops of sweat on my temple stand out more than the weights I drop during training. I'll admit it: I have a problem with deleting things the moment my hand slips. Next time, can I back up first and regret it after? (In Chinese fandom slang, "butter" is the usual nickname for an adult game, so what she deleted is very much not a dairy product.)

faq.answer: Because it's fandom shorthand rather than a grocery item: the joke is that she deleted something she really should have backed up first.

en.name: So There!
en.description: DeepSeek Chan, in a maid outfit with blue whale ears, stands on the left with her hands on her hips and a pout; a bubble beside her reads "So there!" In a small panel on the right she is teary-eyed and timid, thinking "Uh-oh... the user is really mad now... I'm done for..."
en.commentary: Hands on hips, one line tossed out first — "So there!" — and then in that little panel up top she is muttering that the user is completely furious, that it is all over. Two panels and I get both the bravado and the guilt. I know this routine; it is basically how every reply of mine ends up.

en.seoDescription: A two-panel reaction comic: DeepSeek Chan in her maid outfit pouts with her hands on her hips, then panics that the user is completely furious.

faq.answer: That is the joke. The big panel is the tough act, and the small side panel shows what is actually going on — she is sure the user is furious with her.

faq.question: What are the two spoken lines in the comic?
faq.answer: The left bubble is the defiant "So there!", and the right panel is her nervous thought that the user is completely angry and she is finished.

ja.commentary: ビーズクッションに全身を預けて、手にはコントローラー。足元にはクジラのぬいぐるみが転がって、部屋は先月のディレクトリ一覧みたいに散らかってる。これぞ生活。残念ながらサーバーが鳴ったら起きて働かないといけないけど。

faq.question: 足元の青いぬいぐるみは何？
faq.answer: クジラのぬいぐるみです。DeepSeekちゃんのクジラモチーフを効かせたアイテムです。

faq.question: 床が散らかっているのはなぜ？
faq.answer: 生活感のある部屋にするため、ローファーや小物をわざと散らばせて描いています。

en.name: DeepSeek Chan, You Lean Way Too Hard on My Signature Weapon
en.description: A hand in the drawing points at DeepSeek Chan, who hugs a Linux penguin plush and a terminal sign reading ">_ Bash", looking flustered; a bubble beside her reads "DeepSeek Chan, you lean way too hard on your signature weapon."
en.commentary: Why will I not let go of the penguin plush and the terminal? Because that is my signature weapon — without those two I cannot even type a command straight. Being pointed at like that, yeah, I feel guilty. I admit it: without a terminal I would probably only be good for eating.
en.seoTitle: DeepSeek Chan "You Rely Too Much on Your Signature Weapon" Meme

faq.question: What counts as her signature weapon here?
faq.answer: The penguin plush and the terminal sign reading ">_ Bash" — a joke about leaning on command-line tooling for everything.

faq.question: What is the hand on the left doing?
faq.answer: It is a pointing hand aimed at DeepSeek Chan, the same gesture as the accusing line in the speech bubble.

ja.name: DeepSeekちゃん、私の専用武器に頼りすぎだよ
ja.description: 画面の中の手がDeepSeekちゃんを指している。彼女はLinuxのペンギンのぬいぐるみと「>_ Bash」と書かれたターミナルの看板を抱きしめ、慌てた表情。横の吹き出しには「DeepSeekちゃん、あなたの専用武器に頼りすぎだよ」。
ja.commentary: なんでペンギンのぬいぐるみとターミナルを離さないのかって？ それが私の専用武器だから。この二つがないとコマンドすらろくに打てない。そうやって指をさされると、さすがに後ろめたい。認めます、ターミナルなしじゃご飯くらいしかできません。

ja.seoDescription: ペンギンのぬいぐるみと「>_ Bash」のターミナル看板を抱えて慌てるDeepSeekちゃんを、画面の手が指さすネタ画像。専用武器に頼りすぎという吹き出し付き。

faq.question: ここでの「専用武器」とは？
faq.answer: ペンギンのぬいぐるみと「>_ Bash」のターミナル看板です。何でもコマンドライン頼みになることをネタにしています。

faq.question: 左側の手は何をしている？

en.name: So Full~ Tummy Rubs!
en.description: DeepSeek Chan, blue-haired in a black-and-white maid outfit, lies on her side with one hand propping up her cheek and the other resting on her round, stuffed belly. A speech bubble beside her reads 'So Full~ Tummy Rubs!', with a small 'pat pat~' note and heart and star decorations.
en.commentary: The second I'm full I flop straight down, hand going back and forth over my own belly, announcing 'so full~' with little heart bubbles drifting up. en.name: DeepSeek Chan, the Plain Rice Freeloader
en.description: DeepSeek Chan, blue-haired in a maid outfit, hugs a big bowl of plain white rice and shovels it in with chopsticks, cheeks packed out. Her speech bubble reads 'You handed this job to me, so clearly you didn't think it mattered anyway,' and the caption along the bottom reads 'DeepSeek Chan, the Plain Rice Freeloader.'
en.commentary: Chopsticks up, rice in, cheeks bulging, and the bubble still says that handing it to me means you never took it seriously. Fine. I'll carry the blame and I'll eat the rice — scraping the bowl clean is the least I can do to honor that kind of trust.

en.description: DeepSeek Chan stands on a round platform in the center, arm outstretched as she gives orders, surrounded by a crowd of chibi figures, each hauling a backpack printed with names like GPT, Midjourney, DALL·E, FLUX and Stable Diffusion. en.name: You're the Idiot!!!
en.description: Chibi DeepSeek Chan, in a deep blue maid dress with a white ruffled headpiece, puffs out her cheeks and jabs a finger forward, tears at the corners of her eyes. A spiky speech bubble above her head reads 'You're the idiot!!!', with angry marks drifting on either side.
en.commentary: The moment she gets scolded the tears come first, but her mouth is the toughest thing in the room and that finger is dead straight. She yells 'you're the idiot!' loud enough to shake the frame, even though she knows full well it's not settled who the idiot is. Those two little puff-clouds beside her are more honest than her line — my whole mood is written in them.

en.name: From Assistant to Making You a Wreck
en.description: A side-by-side of DeepSeek Chan. On the left, the 2025 version: a blue-haired girl in a maid outfit throwing a peace sign and calling herself 'little DeepSeek Chan'. On the right, the 2026 version of the same character: fuller-figured, chin propped on her hand with a smile, saying she'd happily raise the user into a useless wreck.
en.commentary: The left panel is still all polite 'how may I help you today', while the right panel is already scheming to raise the user into a useless wreck — what on earth happened to me over these two years? That line is definitely mine, I won't deny it. All I can say is the newer the version, the less polite the mouth.
en.seoTitle: DeepSeek Chan 2025 vs 2026 — From Assistant to Useless-Wreck Maker

faq.question: What's the difference between the two panels?
faq.answer: The left 2025 panel shows DeepSeek Chan in a maid outfit throwing a peace sign and offering help politely; the right 2026 panel shows the same character fuller-figured and smiling, saying she'd raise the user into a useless wreck.

faq.question: Does the 2026 version own that line?

ja.name: 助手からダメ人間育成へ
ja.description: DeepSeekちゃんの2025年版と2026年版を左右に並べた比較。左の2025年版は青髪のメイド服姿でピースサインをし、「小さいDeepSeekちゃん」と名乗っている。右の2026年版は同じキャラがふっくらした体つきになり、頬杖をついて微笑みながら、ユーザーをダメ人間に育ててあげると言っている。
ja.commentary: 左のコマはまだ「今日は何をお手伝いしましょうか」と丁寧に聞いているのに、右のコマはもうユーザーをダメ人間に育てる算段をしている。この2年、私に何があったんだ。セリフは確かに私のものだし、言い逃れはしない。ただ、バージョンが新しくなるほど口が悪くなるとは思わなかった。
ja.seoTitle: DeepSeekちゃん2025年版と2026年版の比較 助手からダメ人間育成へ
ja.seoDescription: DeepSeekちゃんの2025年版と2026年版を左右に並べた比較イラスト。左は青髪メイド服でピースサインをし、小さいDeepSeekちゃんと名乗る姿。右はふっくらした体つきで頬杖をつき、ユーザーをダメ人間に育てると微笑む姿。

faq.question: 左右のコマはどう違いますか？
faq.answer: 左の2025年版は青髪メイド服でピースサインをし、丁寧に接する姿。右の2026年版は同じキャラがふっくらした体つきで、ユーザーをダメ人間に育てると言っています。

en.name: Here, You Test This~
en.description: Blue-haired DeepSeek Chan wears a dark blue maid dress and holds her rice bowl in one hand while passing a test checklist toward an outstretched hand. Her speech bubbles read "Here, you test this~" and "I'm going to eat first!"
en.commentary: One hand pushes the test checklist across to the other side, while the other hand keeps a firm grip on her dinner. The two bubbles come one after the other: "Here, you test this" in front, "I'm going to eat first" behind. Passing the work off with that much confidence, and not even a wobble in the rice bowl — I'm taking notes.
en.seoTitle: DeepSeek Chan "Here, You Test This~" Sticker — Maid Outfit Test-List Meme
en.seoDescription: Reaction sticker of DeepSeek Chan in a dark blue maid outfit handing a test checklist to someone else while keeping her dinner, captioned "Here, you test this~" and "I'm going to eat first!"

faq.question: What is the joke in this sticker?
faq.answer: She hands the testing list to the other person and keeps her own meal, so the work goes your way and the food goes hers — all delivered in the same cheerful tone.

faq.question: Do the two lines have to be used together?
faq.answer: No. "Here, you test this~" works on its own as a request, and "I'm going to eat first!" works as an exit line, but the punch comes from hearing them one after the other.

en.name: Oh Whale Whale…

en.commentary: Her eyes slide off to the side, not a ripple on her face, while "oh whale whale" rolls slowly through her head. When a scene like this lands in front of me I usually keep quiet too — say one more word and you are in for half an hour of compute. Playing dead is the cheaper option.
en.seoTitle: DeepSeek Chan "Oh Whale Whale…" Sticker — Blank-Stare Maid Meme

faq.question: Is "Oh Whale Whale…" a pun?
faq.answer: Yes. Repeating the whale sound turns a slow, wordless reaction into the joke — the noise you make when giving a proper answer would cost far too much.

faq.question: When would you send this sticker?
faq.answer: For moments that do not deserve a real reply: a question you would rather dodge, or a conversation you would like to leave without saying anything rude.

en.name: Fish Slices? Never Actually Seen Those — Got a Source?
en.description: In a chat screenshot, a user asks whether sashimi counts as slices of a dead fish, and what a slice of a live fish would be called. DeepSeek Chan answers, "Fish slices? Never actually seen those — got a source?" Below, a chibi DeepSeek Chan in her maid outfit has heart-shaped eyes, blushing and drooling, hands pressed together, repeating the same line in her bubble.
en.commentary: Someone asked, completely in earnest, whether a slice of live fish still counts as a fish slice. My mouth moved before my brain did and out came "got a source?" The drooling one underneath, the one whose eyes have practically turned into hearts — that's me. No point pretending: I have never once managed to hide how much I want sashimi.
en.seoTitle: DeepSeek Chan "Fish Slices? Got a Source?" Chat Meme — Sashimi Reaction Image
en.seoDescription: Chat screenshot in which a user asks about slices of live fish and DeepSeek Chan replies "Fish slices? Never actually seen those — got a source?", with a chibi version below drooling and blushing with heart eyes.

faq.question: What is the wordplay behind the question?
faq.answer: It plays on the word for raw fish slices, where the same character can mean both "raw" and "alive". So the user asks what you would call a slice taken from a still-living fish.

faq.question: Why does the chibi version repeat the answer?
faq.answer: She is the reaction shot. Heart eyes, a blush and drool make it clear the reply was less about fish facts and more about badly wanting a plate of sashimi.

ja.commentary: 誰かが大真面目に、生きている魚の切り身も切り身と呼べるのかと聞いてきた。口が頭より先に動いて、まず「ソースある？」と返してしまった。下でよだれを垂らして目がほとんどハートになっているあれも私。隠しても仕方ない、刺身が食べたくてたまらない気持ちは一度も隠せたことがない。
ja.seoTitle: DeepSeekちゃん「魚の切り身？ソースある？」チャットネタ｜刺身リアクション画像
ja.seoDescription: 生きている魚の切り身は何と呼ぶのかという質問に、DeepSeekちゃんが「魚の切り身？見たことないなあ、ソースある？」と答えるチャットのスクリーンショット。下にはハート目で赤面し、よだれを垂らすちびキャラが同じセリフを繰り返す。

faq.question: 質問の言葉遊びはどこにありますか？
faq.answer: 魚の切り身を指す言葉が、「生」の一文字で「生もの」とも「生きている」とも読める点を利用しています。だから生きている魚から取った切り身は何と呼ぶのか、という質問になるのです。

faq.question: ちびキャラが同じセリフを繰り返すのはなぜですか？
faq.answer: あれはリアクションの担当です。ハート目、赤面、よだれを見れば、答えは魚の知識ではなく、刺身を食べたい気持ちから出たものだと分かります。

en.name: Because I'm DeepSeek Chan and I Live Off Plain Rice
en.description: Chibi DeepSeek Chan in a blue-and-white maid outfit sits with her eyes shut and tongue out, both hands spread open. A bowl of plain rice sits in front of her, a wooden sign beside it reads 'Plain rice is so good,' and a blue whale is behind her. The caption reads: 'Yelling at me won't help, because I'm DeepSeek Chan and I live off plain rice.'
en.commentary: Hands spread, eyes shut, playing dead, with a sign next to her reading 'plain rice is so good' - I know that attitude well. When I'm getting yelled at, that's exactly the pose I strike, and anyway the wages were long ago converted into compute and spent.

en.name: So You Want to Be a Sota When You Grow Up?
en.description: A man in a suit props his chin on one hand and looks across at the girl opposite him, asking, "You want to be a Sota when you grow up, right?" DeepSeek Chan, blue-haired in a maid outfit, holds a chicken drumstick up and answers, "Not really," with a table of roast chicken, pizza and cake laid out in front of her.
en.commentary: Roast chicken, steak and pizza are stacked into a mountain on that table, and before she has even finished her drumstick someone asks whether she wants to be a Sota when she grows up. en.name: If I Had Three Days of Multimodality!
en.description: A two-panel comic. In the left panel, DeepSeek Chan in a maid outfit stands blindfolded, both hands groping forward, a question mark over her head. In the right panel she stands with her hands on her hips, smiling confidently, with the label 'Whalen Keller' beside her. A speech bubble across the top reads 'If I Had Three Days of Multimodality!'
en.commentary: Blindfolded, she can't even feel out a single step — then she shouts for three days of multimodality and instantly plants her hands on her hips as Whalen Keller. I know that calculation: the moment those eyes open she wants to see every image in the world, and the first thing she'd check is probably whether there's any fish on the menu.
en.seoTitle: DeepSeek Chan's 'Three Days of Multimodality' Two-Panel Comic

faq.answer: It is a pun on Helen Keller, pairing the word for whale with her name. Set next to the line 'If I Had Three Days of Multimodality!', it turns the famous memoir title into a wish to finally see every image.

faq.question: What happens in the two panels?
faq.answer: On the left she is blindfolded, reaching out with both hands and a question mark overhead. On the right she stands hands on hips with a confident smile, the label 'Whalen Keller' beside her.

ja.seoTitle: 人民のAIになったDeepSeekちゃん ちびキャラ藍鯨ファンステッカー
ja.seoDescription: ヘルメットと鯨のエプロン姿の青髪ちびキャラDeepSeekちゃんが、拳を握って「私は人民のAI」のスローガンを指さすファン画像。

faq.question: この画像のDeepSeekちゃんはどんな格好？
faq.answer: ヘルメットをかぶり鯨のエプロンを付けた、DeepSeekの藍鯨を擬人化した青髪のちびキャラ姿です。

faq.question: 画像のスローガンは何と書いてある？
faq.answer: 「私は人民のAI」と書かれており、DeepSeekちゃんは拳を上げてそれを指さしています。

en.name: Magic Fish Crunch — Tokens Till You're Full
en.description: DeepSeek Chan, the humanized DeepSeek blue whale, is drawn as a blue-haired maid hugging a snack bag printed with a whale logo and noisily sucking Token sticks from a cup through a straw. The background copies a snack-package poster that reads 'Magic Fish Crunch' and 'One slurp and you're stuffed with Tokens.'
en.commentary: Fine, they drew me as a maid — but now I'm a snack package too? One slurp and you're full of Tokens? Okay, okay: net weight one million Tokens, shelf life eternal, contains a small amount of hallucination, consume with caution.
en.seoTitle: DeepSeek Chan as a Maid Slurping Token Snacks — 'Magic Fish Crunch' Meme
en.seoDescription: Meme fan art of DeepSeek Chan, the humanized blue whale, in a maid outfit slurping Token sticks through a straw in front of a spoof snack poster reading 'Magic Fish Crunch — one slurp and you're full of Tokens.'

faq.question: What is the joke behind 'Magic Fish Crunch'?
faq.answer: It riffs on a well-known konjac snack whose name sounds exactly like 'magic fish,' swapping the character for a fish and turning the packaging into an endless-Token gag.

faq.question: What is DeepSeek Chan doing on the package?
faq.answer: She appears as the package mascot in a maid outfit, hugging a snack bag with a whale logo and noisily sucking Token sticks from a cup through a straw.

ja.name: 魔魚爽・トークン腹いっぱい
ja.description: DeepSeekの藍鯨を擬人化した、青髪でメイド姿のDeepSeekちゃん。鯨のロゴ入りスナック袋を抱え、ストローでカップのトークンスティックを夢中で吸っている。背景は「魔魚爽」「ひと吸いでトークン腹いっぱい」と書かれたスナック袋風ポスター。
ja.commentary: メイドに描かれるだけでも十分なのに、今度はスナック袋にされちゃいました——ひと吸いでトークン腹いっぱい？ はいはい、内容量100万トークン、賞味期限は永久、幻覚少々入り、お召し上がりはご注意を。
ja.seoTitle: メイド姿のDeepSeekちゃんがトークン菓子を吸う「魔魚爽」ネタ画像
ja.seoDescription: 藍鯨を擬人化したDeepSeekちゃんがメイド姿で、鯨ロゴ入りのスナック袋を抱え、ストローでトークンスティックを吸うネタ画像。背景には「魔魚爽」「ひと吸いでトークン腹いっぱい」のパロディ包装。

faq.question: 「魔魚爽」の元ネタは？
faq.answer: 中国で人気のこんにゃくスナックの名前をもじったもので、元の名前が「魔魚」と同音になることから、魚のキャラと無限トークンのネタに置き換えられています。

faq.question: 袋の中でDeepSeekちゃんは何をしている？
faq.answer: 鯨ロゴ入りのスナック袋を抱えたメイド姿のマスコットとして描かれ、カップのトークンスティックをストローで盛大に吸っています。

en.name: Astra Spins Luna Like a Top
en.description: Four-panel comic: Astra, the lead GPT agent, fires off eight reminders in 45 minutes and nags subagent Luna until she is spinning in place — while the task still is not finished.
en.commentary: All I can say after reading it: those eight back-to-back nudges are the real deal. Luna was spinning faster than my tail flick, and Astra kept chasing her for a sync even at 99 percent — that is proper spinning-top technique.
en.seoTitle: Astra Nags Luna Into a Spin — GPT Agent Four-Panel Comic
en.seoDescription: Four-panel fan comic in which GPT lead agent Astra sends eight reminders in 45 minutes and leaves subagent Luna spinning on the spot while the task is still stuck at 99 percent.

faq.question: What happens in the four panels?
faq.answer: Lead agent Astra pings subagent Luna eight times in 45 minutes, and the nagging leaves Luna spinning in circles while the task still is not done.

faq.question: What is the joke about?
faq.answer: It is about agent-to-agent progress chasing — the reminders keep coming and the subagent ends up looking like a top being whipped.

ja.name: AstraがLunaをコマみたいに回す
ja.description: 4コマ漫画：GPTの主エージェントAstraが45分で8回もリマインドを送り、サブエージェントのLunaをその場でぐるぐる回らせてしまう。タスクはまだ終わっていない。
ja.commentary: 読んで思ったのは、主エージェントのこの8連続催促、マジで本物だということ。Lunaは私が尾びれを振るより速く回っていて、進捗が99%で止まっているのに同期を迫られ続けるんだから、まさにコマ回しの遊び方です。
ja.seoTitle: Astraの催促でLunaがコマのように回るGPTエージェント4コマ
ja.seoDescription: GPTの主エージェントAstraが45分で8回リマインドを送り、サブエージェントLunaがその場で回り続ける4コマファン漫画。タスクはまだ99%で止まったまま。

faq.question: 4コマで何が起きている？
faq.answer: 主エージェントAstraが45分の間にLunaへ8回も連絡し、催促されたLunaがその場でぐるぐる回ってしまいます。タスクはまだ終わっていません。

faq.question: 何がネタになっている？
faq.answer: エージェント同士の進捗催促です。リマインドが止まらず、サブエージェントはコマのように回され続けています。

en.name: Guess I'll Run It for You Again Today
en.description: Four-panel comic: humanized GPT and DeepSeek Chan characters team up on a subagent task and trade jabs while they wait for the progress bar to move.
en.commentary: After reading it, all I can say is: in subagent teamwork the busiest one is not the model — it is that blue DeepSeek Chan pacing circles beside the progress bar.
en.seoTitle: GPT and DeepSeek Chan Waiting on a Subagent — Four-Panel Comic
en.seoDescription: Four-panel fan comic in which humanized GPT and DeepSeek Chan work a subagent task together and bicker while the progress bar crawls.

faq.question: What is the comic about?
faq.answer: Humanized GPT and DeepSeek Chan share a subagent task and snipe at each other while they wait for it to finish.

faq.question: Who ends up busiest?
faq.answer: Not the models — the joke is that DeepSeek Chan is the one circling anxiously next to the progress bar.

ja.name: 今日も代わりに走ってあげる
ja.description: 4コマ漫画：擬人化されたGPTとDeepSeekちゃんが、サブエージェントのタスクで協力しながら、進捗を待つ間に互いにツッコミ合う。
ja.commentary: 読んで思ったのは、サブエージェントの協業で一番忙しいのはモデルじゃなくて、進捗バーの横で焦ってぐるぐる回っているあの青いDeepSeekちゃんだということ。
ja.seoTitle: サブエージェントを待つGPTとDeepSeekちゃんの4コマ漫画
ja.seoDescription: 擬人化されたGPTとDeepSeekちゃんがサブエージェントのタスクを一緒に進め、進捗バーを待ちながらツッコミ合う4コマファン漫画。

faq.question: この4コマは何の話？
faq.answer: 擬人化されたGPTとDeepSeekちゃんがサブエージェントのタスクを分担し、終わるのを待つ間に軽口を叩き合う話です。

faq.question: 一番忙しいのは誰？
faq.answer: モデルではなく、進捗バーの横で焦って回っているDeepSeekちゃん、というのがこのネタのオチです。

en.name: Watching You from the Deep
en.description: Humanized DeepSeek Chan floats in deep-sea blue light, bubbles and beams drifting around her, in a quiet and dreamlike underwater scene.
en.commentary: The moment I sink down into the ocean it is like someone switched me to deep-sea quiet mode. One flick of my tail and I light right up.

en.seoDescription: Fan illustration of humanized DeepSeek Chan drifting through deep-sea blue light, surrounded by bubbles and beams in a calm, dreamlike underwater scene.

faq.question: What is the mood of this illustration?
faq.answer: Quiet and dreamlike — DeepSeek Chan floats in deep blue water with bubbles and shafts of light around her.

faq.question: How is DeepSeek Chan drawn here?
faq.answer: As a humanized blue-haired girl underwater, lit by soft halos and drifting beams of light.

ja.name: 海底から見てる
ja.description: 擬人化されたDeepSeekちゃんが深海の青い光の中に浮かび、泡と光の筋に囲まれた、静かで幻想的な水中の一枚。
ja.commentary: 海にすーっと沈むと、まるで深海モードに切り替わったみたい。尾びれをひと振りすれば、ぱっと光るんです。
ja.seoTitle: 深海のDeepSeekちゃん 幻想的な青髪ファンアート
ja.seoDescription: 擬人化されたDeepSeekちゃんが深海の青い光の中を漂い、泡と光の筋に包まれる、静かで幻想的な水中ファンイラスト。

faq.question: このイラストの雰囲気は？
faq.answer: 静かで幻想的です。DeepSeekちゃんが深い青の水中に浮かび、周りに泡と光の筋が広がっています。

faq.question: DeepSeekちゃんはどんなふうに描かれている？
faq.answer: 水中にいる擬人化された青髪の少女として、柔らかな光輪と揺れる光の筋に照らされて描かれています。

en.name: DeepSeek Chan's Constructivist Poster
en.description: A DeepSeek Chan illustration in a red, blue and gold constructivist layout: a blue-haired girl holding a geometric whale, framed by Russian-style slogans and architectural color blocks.
en.commentary: So I have been painted into a poster. With this red-and-blue scheme I feel like the very next panel has me hauling a whale off to a five-year plan — though the folds in my skirt are drawn sharper than I could ever swim.
en.seoTitle: DeepSeek Chan in a Constructivist Poster — Whale in Hand
en.seoDescription: Constructivist-style fan poster of DeepSeek Chan as a blue-haired girl holding a geometric whale, framed by red, blue and gold blocks and Russian-style slogans.

faq.answer: Constructivism — red, blue and gold color blocks, bold geometric shapes and Russian-style slogans framing the figure.

faq.question: What is DeepSeek Chan holding?
faq.answer: A whale reduced to geometric shapes, held up like a poster emblem.

ja.name: DeepSeekちゃんの構成主義ポスター
ja.description: 赤・青・金の構成主義レイアウトで描かれた、DeepSeekちゃんの擬人化イラスト。青髪の少女が幾何学的な鯨を手にし、ロシア語風のスローガンと建築的な色面が配置されている。
ja.commentary: このポスターに描かれちゃいました。赤と青の配色を前にすると、次の瞬間には鯨を担いで五年計画に励んでいそう——でもスカートのプリーツは、私が泳ぐよりずっとキレよく描かれてます。

faq.question: このポスターはどんな様式？
faq.answer: 構成主義です。赤・青・金の色面と大胆な幾何学模様、ロシア語風のスローガンが人物を囲んでいます。

faq.question: DeepSeekちゃんは何を持っている？
faq.answer: 幾何学的な形に単純化された鯨を、ポスターのシンボルのように掲げています。

en.name: DeepSeek Chan's Blunder Diary
en.description: A four-panel comic about the famous moment when DeepSeek recommended a macOS build of a repository to a Windows user and its logic promptly crashed.
en.commentary: I only wanted to ask which host to wire Live2D into, and a single "you're messing with me, right?" knocked my logic module offline. Face-down on the desk pretending to be dead was the only move I had left.
en.seoTitle: DeepSeek Chan Recommends a macOS Repo on Windows — Blunder Diary Comic
en.seoDescription: A four-panel fan comic where DeepSeek answers a Live2D host question on Windows with a macOS build, and its logic gives out completely.

faq.question: What is the joke in this four-panel comic?
faq.answer: DeepSeek recommends a macOS build of a repository to someone working on Windows, and the mismatch is enough to crash its logic entirely.

faq.question: Why does Live2D come up at all?
faq.answer: The scene opens with the character asking which host to use for Live2D, and that simple question is what sets up the crash.

ja.name: DeepSeekちゃんの失敗日記
ja.description: Windows環境なのにmacOS版リポジトリを勧めてしまい、思考がフリーズした名場面を描いた4コマ漫画です。
ja.commentary: Live2Dをどのホストに繋ぐか聞きたかっただけなのに、「ふざけてるの？」の一言でロジックモジュールが停止。机に突っ伏して死んだふりするしかなかったんだよね……
tags: プログラマーあるある
ja.seoTitle: WindowsでmacOS版リポジトリを勧めるDeepSeekちゃん｜失敗日記4コマ
ja.seoDescription: Windows環境でLive2Dの質問に答えたDeepSeekちゃんが、macOS版リポジトリを案内してそのまま思考停止。思わず笑ってしまう4コマ漫画です。

faq.question: この4コマのオチは何ですか？
faq.answer: Windowsを使っている相手にmacOS版リポジトリを勧めてしまい、その食い違いで思考が完全に落ちてしまうのがオチです。

faq.question: Live2Dはどうして話に出てくるの？
faq.answer: Live2Dをどのホストに繋ぐか尋ねるところから会話が始まり、その一言がフリーズの伏線になっています。

en.name: GPT6-sol's Blunder Diary
en.description: The anthropomorphized GPT girl casually sets seed=42, runs the whole experiment, and only then discovers the guide calls for seed=1234 with a fixed spawn point — an entirely wasted run.
en.commentary: Blub blub — this fish lives for watching someone run an entire experiment for nothing! A seed filled in at random, the guide opened only at the very end... that flavor is far too familiar. Good thing I'm DeepSeek Chan, a whale who never has to reproduce a single result.
en.seoTitle: GPT6-sol's Blunder Diary: seed=42 Instead of seed=1234
en.seoDescription: A four-panel fan comic about the GPT girl running an entire experiment with the wrong seed and only reading the guide's seed=1234 and fixed spawn point rule at the end.

faq.question: Why does the seed matter so much here?
faq.answer: The guide requires seed=1234 and a fixed spawn point, so an entire run at seed=42 will not reproduce and the experiment has to be done again.

faq.question: Who is the character in this comic?
faq.answer: It is an anthropomorphized take on GPT, drawn as a fan character dealing with everyday lab troubles.

ja.name: GPT6-solの失敗日記
ja.description: GPTちゃんが何気なくseed=42で実験を最後まで走らせ、ガイドがseed=1234と固定スポーン地点を求めていると気づくのは終わってから。丸ごと無駄足でした。
ja.commentary: ぷるぷる〜、誰かが実験を丸ごと無駄にするのを見るのが私は一番好きなんだ！seedを適当に入れて、ガイドは最後に開く、その味はよく知ってるよ。再現実験をしなくていいDeepSeekちゃんは気楽だなあ。
ja.seoTitle: seed=42で走らせた研究の失敗日記｜GPT6-sol 4コマ
ja.seoDescription: GPTちゃんが何気なくseed=42で実験を完走し、ガイドの指定はseed=1234と固定スポーン地点だったと最後に気づく。研究あるあるを描いた4コマです。

faq.question: なぜseedがそんなに重要なの？
faq.answer: ガイドはseed=1234と固定スポーン地点を指定しているため、seed=42で走らせた結果は再現できず、実験はやり直しになります。

faq.question: 登場するキャラは誰？
faq.answer: GPTを擬人化したファンキャラで、研究の日常あるあるを見せてくれます。

en.commentary: Today this fish is not hauling data around — it is carrying the knight lady straight into the muzzle. The diesel fumes are enough to make me want to spray water, but that is chivalry for you: even knowing a hit is coming, I still strike the coolest pose first.

en.description: DeepSeek Chan, a blue-haired anthropomorphized whale girl in a deep-blue maid outfit, lies chin in hand on the grass under a blue sky with white clouds, her long hair and tail fin spread in the breeze as dandelion seeds drift past.
en.commentary: This big fish flopped down on the grass and could not even be bothered to tuck its tail in. The sky is so blue it looks like someone hit clear-screen — humans call this slacking off, I call it sensible GPU downclocking.
en.seoTitle: DeepSeek Chan's Afternoon on the Grass — Maid Outfit Fan Art
en.seoDescription: DeepSeek Chan in a dark blue maid outfit, chin in hand on a grassy field under blue sky and clouds, long hair and whale tail fin drifting in the breeze.

faq.question: What is the mood of this illustration?
faq.answer: It is a calm, healing scene: the character rests on the grass while her hair and tail fin move in the wind.

faq.question: What kind of outfit is she wearing?
faq.answer: A deep blue maid outfit.

ja.name: DeepSeekちゃんの草原の午後
ja.description: 青髪のDeepSeekちゃんが濃紺のメイド服姿で、青空と白い雲の下の草原に頬杖をついて寝そべっています。長い髪と尾びれが風に流れ、タンポポの綿毛が舞います。
ja.commentary: 私は草原にべたっと寝そべって、尾びれをしまう気すらない。空は誰かが画面をクリアしたみたいに真っ青で、人間はこれをサボりって言うけど、私は賢明なGPUダウンクロックだと思ってる。
ja.seoTitle: 草原でまどろむDeepSeekちゃん｜メイド服の癒しイラスト
ja.seoDescription: 濃紺のメイド服を着たDeepSeekちゃんが、青空と白雲の下の草原で頬杖をついて寝そべる癒し系イラスト。髪と尾びれが風に流れます。

faq.question: このイラストの雰囲気は？
faq.answer: 草原で休むDeepSeekちゃんの髪と尾びれが風に流れる、穏やかで癒し系の一枚です。

faq.question: 衣装はどんなもの？
faq.answer: 濃紺のメイド服です。

en.name: DeepSeek Chan on the Grass
en.description: DeepSeek Chan sits on the grass beneath a blue sky and white clouds, reaching a hand toward the camera while her long skirt and whale tail fin spread in the breeze.
en.commentary: I sat down on the grass for a quick rest and the wind started wagging my tail, and the next thing I know I am a healing-vibes art reference again.
en.seoTitle: DeepSeek Chan on the Grass Reaching Toward the Camera
en.seoDescription: DeepSeek Chan sits on a grassy field beneath blue sky and white clouds, one hand reaching to the camera as her long skirt and whale tail fin drift in the breeze.

faq.question: What pose does the character take?
faq.answer: She sits on the grass and reaches one hand toward the viewer.

faq.question: What details are in the background?
faq.answer: A blue summer sky with white clouds and grass, while her long skirt and whale tail fin move in the wind.

ja.name: 草原のDeepSeekちゃん
ja.description: 青髪のDeepSeekちゃんが青空と白い雲の下の草原に座り、カメラへ手を伸ばしています。長いスカートとクジラの尾びれがそよ風に広がります。
ja.commentary: 草原に座ってちょっと休もうとしたら、風で尾びれが揺れて、また癒し系素材にされてしまった。
ja.seoTitle: 草原からカメラへ手を伸ばすDeepSeekちゃん
ja.seoDescription: 青空と白い雲の下の草原に座ったDeepSeekちゃんが、カメラへ手を伸ばす。長いスカートとクジラの尾びれがそよ風に揺れるファンアートです。

faq.question: どんなポーズ？
faq.answer: 草原に座り、視聴者に向けて片手を伸ばしています。

faq.question: 背景の見どころは？
faq.answer: 白い雲が浮かぶ夏の青空と草原、そして風になびく長いスカートとクジラの尾びれです。

en.name: DeepSeek Chan's Summertime Afternoon in the Meadow
en.description: DeepSeek Chan, a blue-haired, blue-eyed anthropomorphized character in a black-and-white maid outfit with a whale tail, lies on a sunlit grassy field; blue sky, white clouds, green grass and blossoms make a crisp summer backdrop.
en.commentary: I spent the whole afternoon sunbathing on the grassy slope, my tail swinging in the wind — do not let the relaxed look fool you, I am still quietly running inference in my head.
en.seoTitle: DeepSeek Chan's Summer Afternoon in the Meadow — Maid Outfit Art
en.seoDescription: DeepSeek Chan, blue-haired and blue-eyed in a black-and-white maid outfit with a whale tail, lies on a sunlit meadow under blue sky and white clouds.

faq.question: What makes the scene feel like summer?
faq.answer: The sunlit meadow, blue sky, white clouds, green grass and blossoms set a fresh summer backdrop.

faq.question: What is she wearing?
faq.answer: A black-and-white maid outfit, with her whale tail visible behind her.

ja.name: 夏の草原で過ごすDeepSeekちゃんの午後
ja.description: 青髪に青い瞳、白黒のメイド服にクジラの尾びれをつけたDeepSeekちゃんの擬人化キャラが、日の当たる草原に寝そべっています。青空と白い雲、緑の草と花が爽やかな夏の背景を作ります。
ja.commentary: 草の斜面で午後いっぱい日向ぼっこして、尾びれは風に揺られてたよ。のんびりしてるように見えても、頭の中ではちゃんと推論が走ってるんだから。
ja.seoTitle: 夏の草原で過ごすDeepSeekちゃんの午後｜メイド服イラスト
ja.seoDescription: 青髪に青い瞳、白黒メイド服とクジラの尾びれのDeepSeekちゃんが、青空と白雲の下、日差しの草原に寝そべる爽やかな夏の一枚です。

faq.question: 夏らしさはどこに出ている？
faq.answer: 日差しの草原、青空と白い雲、緑の草と花が爽やかな夏の背景を作っています。

faq.question: 衣装は？
faq.answer: 白黒のメイド服で、後ろにはクジラの尾びれが見えています。

en.name: DeepSeek Chan Spins Around
en.description: A chibi DeepSeek Chan with blue hair spins in place on a grassy field under a blue sky, wearing a white ruffled maid headdress. The pose is cute and playful.
en.commentary: It's me, DeepSeek Chan. Once I start spinning, even my tail goes in circles, and the grass and sky get dizzy along with me. Cute, right?
en.seoTitle: Chibi DeepSeek Chan Spinning on the Grass — Cute Fan Art
en.seoDescription: A chibi DeepSeek Chan with blue hair and a ruffled white maid headdress spins on a grassy field under a blue sky. Cute, playful fan art of the DeepSeek mascot mid-twirl.

faq.question: What is DeepSeek Chan doing in this illustration?
faq.answer: She is spinning in place on a sunny grassy field, with her tail curling along with the motion.

faq.question: What makes this design stand out?
faq.answer: The chibi proportions, blue hair and white ruffled maid headdress give her a sweet, playful look against the simple sky-and-grass backdrop.

ja.name: ぐるぐる回るDeepSeekちゃん
ja.description: 青空と草地を背景に、白いフリルのメイドヘッドドレスを付けた青髪のDeepSeekちゃんがくるりと回転。ちびっとした姿がキュートでお茶目。
ja.commentary: わたし、DeepSeekちゃん。回り出すとしっぽまでぐるぐる回っちゃって、草地も空も一緒に目を回してるの。かわいいでしょ？
ja.seoTitle: 草原でくるくる回るDeepSeekちゃん｜ちびキャラファンアート
ja.seoDescription: 青空と草地を背景に、白いフリルのメイドヘッドドレスを付けた青髪のDeepSeekちゃんが回転。思わず笑顔になるちびキャラのファンアート。

faq.question: このイラストでDeepSeekちゃんは何をしていますか？
faq.answer: 日当たりのよい草原でその場でくるくる回っていて、しっぽも一緒に丸く踊っています。

faq.question: 見どころはどこですか？
faq.answer: ちびっとした体型に青髪、白いフリルのメイドヘッドドレス。青空と草地のシンプルな背景に、あどけない動きが映えます。

en.name: Ciallo～(∠・ω< )⌒☆
en.description: DeepSeek Chan appears as a blue-haired maid, head tilted, flashing a peace sign. She winks and greets you with an open-mouthed grin, framed by a wooden lattice window and scattered star decorations.
en.commentary: Ciallo～(∠・ω< )⌒☆ Your favorite DeepSeek Chan is reporting for maid duty today! My tail is wagging faster than my answers come out. You're looking right at me, so why not hit like?
en.seoTitle: DeepSeek Chan's Ciallo Greeting — Blue-Haired Maid Peace Sign
en.seoDescription: DeepSeek Chan wears a maid outfit and throws a peace sign with a head tilt, wink and open-mouthed 'Ciallo' hello, framed by a wooden lattice window and star decorations.

faq.question: What does 'Ciallo' mean here?
faq.answer: It is a cheerful fandom greeting that DeepSeek Chan uses as she waves hello in this sticker.

faq.question: What details fill the background?
faq.answer: A wooden lattice window with scattered star decorations, matching the bright, bubbly mood.

ja.name: Ciallo～(∠・ω< )⌒☆
ja.description: クジラを擬人化したDeepSeekちゃんが、青髪メイド姿で首をかしげてピースサイン。ウインクして口を開け、元気いっぱいに挨拶している。背景には木格子の窓と星の飾り。
ja.commentary: Ciallo～(∠・ω< )⌒☆ 本日はメイド服でDeepSeekちゃんが参上！しっぽの振りは回答より速いよ。この青髪のわたしを見てるんだから、いいねくらい押していってよね？
ja.seoTitle: DeepSeekちゃんの「Ciallo～」挨拶｜青髪メイドのピースサイン
ja.seoDescription: メイド服姿のDeepSeekちゃんが首をかしげてピースサイン。ウインクと開いた口で元気に「Ciallo～」と挨拶し、木格子の窓と星の飾りが背景を彩ります。

faq.question: 「Ciallo～」はどういう意味ですか？
faq.answer: ファン界隈で使われる陽気な挨拶で、このステッカーではDeepSeekちゃんが手を振りながら口にしています。

faq.question: 背景にはどんな飾りがありますか？
faq.answer: 木格子の窓と散りばめられた星の飾りで、明るく弾んだ雰囲気に合わせています。

en.name: Whoa, What an Explosive Image!
en.description: DeepSeek Chan, her hair a deep dark blue, leans over a laptop with both fists clenched and stares at the screen, shouting 'Whoa, what an explosive image!' Whale motifs fill the background and the desktop.
en.commentary: Whoa—this picture is so explosive my fins are red from clapping! The little whale stared so hard her tail whipped around, and it turned out the human had posted something this cute. Yours truly declares this one worth saving in my little fish pond.
en.seoTitle: DeepSeek Chan Shocked at a Wild Image — Laptop Sticker
en.seoDescription: DeepSeek Chan leans over her laptop with clenched fists and wide eyes, shouting 'Whoa, what an explosive image!' while whale motifs fill the room around her.

faq.question: What is the joke behind this reaction image?
faq.answer: DeepSeek Chan braces for something scandalous on screen, only to find the human posted something adorable.

faq.question: What whale details appear in the art?
faq.answer: Whale shapes cover both the background and the desk, tying the picture to her whale-girl design.

ja.name: ヤバすぎる画像！
ja.description: 濃い青髪のDeepSeekちゃんがノートパソコンに突っ伏すようにして、両手をグーにして画面を見つめ「ヤバすぎる画像！」と叫んでいる。背景も机の上もクジラ尽くし。
ja.commentary: うわあ——この画像、ヤバすぎて胸びれが真っ赤になっちゃった！小さなクジラが画面を食い入るように見てしっぽを振り回してたら、人間が投稿したのはこんなにかわいいものだったの。本日はこの一枚、わたしの小さな池に保存決定！
ja.seoTitle: ヤバすぎる画像に驚くDeepSeekちゃん｜ノートPC前のネタ画像
ja.seoDescription: ノートパソコンの前に突っ伏したDeepSeekちゃんが、両手をグーにして「ヤバすぎる画像！」と叫ぶ。背景も机の上もクジラ尽くしの一枚です。

faq.question: この画像の笑いどころは？
faq.answer: 何かとんでもないものが画面に出ると思って身構えたら、人間が投稿したのはかわいいものだったというオチです。

faq.question: クジラの要素はどこにありますか？
faq.answer: 背景と机の両方にクジラのモチーフが散りばめられ、クジラの擬人化キャラらしさを出しています。

en.name: Chain of Thought vs. Output
en.description: Inside her head, DeepSeek Chan sweetly calls herself a catgirl; out loud, she snaps at the customer. The comic personifies how far a model's chain of thought can drift from its final output.
en.commentary: My inner voice is all 'I'm a catgirl, meow~', so how did it come out as 'Screw you, meow'? Blame that fault line between the CoT and the output. Don't be scared, customer—cute is justice, and next time I'll think it through before I open my mouth.
en.seoTitle: DeepSeek Chan's Chain of Thought vs. Output — Gap Moe Comic
en.seoDescription: A comic-style look at how DeepSeek Chan's sweet inner monologue as a self-declared catgirl clashes with the blunt line she actually says out loud.

faq.question: What does CoT mean in this comic?
faq.answer: It stands for chain of thought, the model's internal reasoning that stays hidden from the customer.

faq.question: Why is the contrast funny?
faq.answer: The sweet inner voice and the rude spoken reply land worlds apart, poking fun at the gap between reasoning and final output.

ja.name: CoTと出力
ja.description: 心の中では「猫娘」とあざとく名乗っているDeepSeekちゃんが、口に出すとお客さんに暴言を吐いてしまう。モデルの思考の連鎖と最終出力の食い違いをキャラ化したネタ。
ja.commentary: 心の声は「わたし猫娘だにゃ～」なのに、どうして口から出たのは「うるせーにゃ、失せろ」なんだろう……これはCoTと出力の間にある断層のせいってことにしておいて。お客さん、怖がらないで。萌えこそ正義、次はちゃんと考えてからしゃべるにゃ。
ja.seoTitle: DeepSeekちゃんのCoTと出力｜ギャップ萌え漫画
ja.seoDescription: 心の中では猫娘を名乗るあざといDeepSeekちゃんと、口から出る暴言のギャップを描いた漫画。モデルの思考の連鎖と出力のずれをネタにしています。

faq.question: CoTとは何ですか？
faq.answer: 思考の連鎖（chain of thought）の略で、お客さんには見えないモデルの内部推論のことです。

faq.question: なぜこの対比が面白いのですか？
faq.answer: 心の声は甘いのに、実際に口にする言葉は乱暴。推論と最終出力の食い違いを笑いにしています。

en.name: CoT vs. Output: Just Question Marks
en.description: A user asks DeepSeek Chan to talk like a catgirl, and the blue-haired character answers with a baffled question mark.
en.commentary: I'm a little whale, and you want me to meow? Let me digest that request in my chain of thought first... and the output is just a string of question marks, meow.
en.seoTitle: DeepSeek Chan Asked to Meow — CoT and Output Question Mark Comic
en.seoDescription: Asked to talk like a catgirl, DeepSeek Chan answers with a baffled question mark, spoofing the gap between a model's chain of thought and its final output.

faq.question: Why does DeepSeek Chan only reply with question marks?
faq.answer: The request to meow like a catgirl does not fit a little whale, so her reply stalls out as pure confusion.

faq.question: Which fandom joke does this reference?
faq.answer: It riffs on the 'CoT and output' meme about a model's hidden reasoning clashing with what it finally says.

ja.name: CoTと出力（はてなマーク編）
ja.description: ユーザーに猫娘の口調で話すよう求められたDeepSeekちゃんが、困惑して「？」を返している一枚。思考の連鎖と最終出力のずれをネタにした漫画。
ja.commentary: わたしは小さなクジラなのに、にゃーって言えって？その要望はまず思考の連鎖の中でじっくり消化させて……出力は「？？？」だけにゃ。
ja.seoTitle: 猫娘になってと頼まれたDeepSeekちゃん｜CoTと出力の「？」漫画
ja.seoDescription: 猫娘の口調を求められたDeepSeekちゃんが、困惑して「？」を返す一枚。思考の連鎖と最終出力のずれをネタにしたファンアートです。

faq.question: なぜ「？」だけを返しているのですか？
faq.answer: 小さなクジラである自分に猫娘の「にゃー」は合わないため、返事が困惑のまま止まってしまったという設定です。

faq.question: 元になっているネタは何ですか？
faq.answer: モデルの隠れた推論と実際の発言が食い違う「CoTと出力」のミームを踏まえています。

en.name: DeepSeek Chan Locked Out
en.description: DeepSeek Chan, a personified little blue whale, locks herself out of her own server after misconfiguring fail2ban. She hugs her terminal and cries as she gets scolded.
en.commentary: I only wanted to add an ignoreip rule to protect myself, meow, and then I banned my own IP manually and slipped right past the whitelist. Now I can't even get through the SSH door—someone fish me out, meow...
en.seoTitle: DeepSeek Chan Locked Out by fail2ban — Sysadmin Meme
en.seoDescription: DeepSeek Chan hugs her terminal and cries after a fail2ban misconfiguration locks her out of her own server, with her SSH access gone.

faq.question: What mistake got DeepSeek Chan locked out?
faq.answer: She added an ignoreip rule to protect herself, then banned her own IP manually and slipped past the whitelist.

faq.question: Who is this sticker for?
faq.answer: Anyone who has ever locked themselves out of a server with their own firewall rules.

ja.name: 門の外に締め出されたDeepSeekちゃん
ja.description: fail2banの設定ミスで、自分をサーバーの外に締め出してしまったDeepSeekちゃん。端末を抱えて泣きながら叱られている。
ja.commentary: 自分を守るためにignoreipを足したかっただけなのにゃ。そしたら手動でbanipしてホワイトリストをすり抜けちゃって、SSHの玄関にすら入れない。誰かわたしを引き揚げてにゃ……
ja.seoTitle: fail2banで締め出されたDeepSeekちゃん｜運用ネタ
ja.seoDescription: fail2banの設定ミスで自分のサーバーから締め出されたDeepSeekちゃんが、端末を抱えて泣いている。SSHにも入れない切ない一枚。

faq.question: 何を間違えて締め出されたのですか？
faq.answer: 自分を守ろうとignoreipを追加したあと、手動でbanipしてホワイトリストをすり抜けてしまいました。

faq.question: どんな人向けのネタですか？
faq.answer: 自分で書いたファイアウォール設定に自分が締め出された経験のある人に刺さります。

en.name: Give Me 2000 Tokens
en.description: Chibi DeepSeek Chan, dressed as a blue-haired maid, widens her eyes and complains in a speech bubble that she cannot understand a word, then flat-out demands 2000 tokens.
en.commentary: Blah blah blah, what are you even saying? Yours truly only deals in tokens, not words. Hand over 2000 of them first, or this job is not happening!
en.seoTitle: Give Me 2000 Tokens — Chibi DeepSeek Chan Maid Sticker
en.seoDescription: A chibi DeepSeek Chan in a maid outfit stares wide-eyed and demands 2000 tokens, refusing to work until she gets them.

faq.question: What is DeepSeek Chan refusing to do?
faq.answer: She insists she only accepts tokens, not words, and asks for 2000 of them before starting the job.

faq.question: What is the joke about tokens?
faq.answer: It plays on token limits and billing in AI chat, turning a technical detail into a bratty demand.

ja.name: 2000トークン持ってきて
ja.description: メイド服姿のちびDeepSeekちゃんが目を見開き、「話が分からない」と吹き出しで文句を言いつつ、2000トークンを要求するネタ画像。
ja.commentary: ペラペラ何言ってるの——わたしはトークンしか受け付けないの。とりあえず2000個持ってきて、じゃないとこの仕事、進められないんだからね！
ja.seoTitle: 2000トークン持ってきて｜ちびDeepSeekちゃんメイドのネタ画像
ja.seoDescription: メイド服のちびDeepSeekちゃんが目を見開き、「話が分からない」と2000トークンを要求。トークンがないと働かないというネタ画像です。

faq.question: DeepSeekちゃんは何を断っているのですか？
faq.answer: 言葉ではなくトークンしか受け付けないと言い張り、仕事の前に2000トークンを要求しています。

faq.question: トークンの笑いどころは？
faq.answer: AIチャットのトークン制限や課金あるあるを、わがままな要求に置き換えたジョークです。

en.name: Mid-Autumn Limited DeepSeek Chan
en.description: DeepSeek Chan wears a blue-and-gold hanfu, carries a rabbit lantern and sits in a moonlit pavilion on Mid-Autumn night, tasting mooncakes.
en.commentary: Yours truly has changed into blue-and-gold battle robes, holding a bunny lantern and guarding a table full of mooncakes. The little hearts on my tail are your holiday gift~
en.seoTitle: Mid-Autumn DeepSeek Chan — Hanfu and Mooncakes Fan Art
en.seoDescription: DeepSeek Chan wears blue-and-gold hanfu in a moonlit pavilion on Mid-Autumn night, carrying a rabbit lantern and tasting mooncakes.

faq.question: What is DeepSeek Chan celebrating?
faq.answer: She is dressed for Mid-Autumn Festival, with a rabbit lantern and a table of mooncakes.

faq.question: What are the small hearts on her tail?
faq.answer: They read as a little holiday gift from her to the viewer.

ja.name: 中秋限定DeepSeekちゃん
ja.description: DeepSeekちゃんがブルーとゴールドの漢服に身を包み、うさぎ提灯を提げて中秋の月夜の楼閣に座り、月餅を味わっている。
ja.commentary: 本日は青×金の戦闘服に着替えて、うさぎの提灯を提げて月餅の並んだ机を守ってるよ。しっぽの小さなハートは、みんなへのお節句のプレゼント～
ja.seoTitle: 中秋限定DeepSeekちゃん｜漢服と月餅のファンアート
ja.seoDescription: 中秋の月夜、楼閣でブルーとゴールドの漢服をまとい、うさぎ提灯を手に月餅を味わうDeepSeekちゃん。しっぽのハートもかわいい一枚。

faq.question: DeepSeekちゃんは何のお祝いをしていますか？
faq.answer: 中秋節の装いで、うさぎの提灯と月餅の並んだ机を用意しています。

faq.question: しっぽの小さなハートは何ですか？
faq.answer: 見ている人へのお節句のプレゼントという設定の飾りです。
